source._comment: Washington is all-mail with NO party registration -> turnout-only. The SoS 'Ballot Return Statistics' report gives ballots returned & % by county during the election, but only via a seasonal dashboard/report; no persistent machine-readable county API was found off-season. STAGED SKELETON: writes 0 until a verified live 2026 feed is wired. The Friday rollout routine finalizes the parser against the live report in Oct. Turnout-only: 'cast' = ballots returned; the map shades by turnout %.
